team.notVisibleForYourRole: The internal roster is read by the founder and admins only.

fieldDesk.title: Field
fieldDesk.subtitle: The shops in your zones, and the ones you recorded yourself.
fieldDesk.noAccess: This screen isn't visible with your role.
fieldDesk.noAccessHint: Working the field needs a zone right or a field-capture right.
fieldDesk.noZones: No zone is assigned to you
fieldDesk.noZonesHint: The founder assigns them. Until then you only see the shops you recorded yourself.
fieldDesk.zonesUnbounded: Your role sees every prospect, not one zone.
fieldDesk.mapLabel: Map of the shops in your zones
fieldDesk.unplaced_one: {{count}} shop has no coordinates and can't be placed.
fieldDesk.unplaced_other: {{count}} shops have no coordinates and can't be placed.
fieldDesk.nothingHereHint: Record the first one you walk past.
fieldDesk.captureIntro: What you saw with your own eyes — that is what makes this worth more than a scraped line.
fieldDesk.observationHint: Required. The sign, the chairs, how busy it was, the software at the till.
fieldDesk.refusalAlreadyKnown: This shop is already known in this city. Nothing was merged.
fieldDesk.refusalOutsideZones: This city isn't in your zones.
fieldDesk.refusalCountry: The country is required, in ISO-2.
fieldDesk.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role doesn't allow field capture.
fieldDesk.setupBody: Setup creates the shop of the signed-in account. The owner signs up with THEIR own account — on your phone if that helps — and you walk them through it. You cannot set one up on someone's behalf.
fieldDesk.mapNothingToPlace: Nothing to place on the map

moderationDesk.title: Moderation
moderationDesk.subtitle: Reported content, applications and profile claims.
moderationDesk.notForYourRoleHint: This screen needs the content or the onboarding permission.
moderationDesk.ruleReason: Hiding requires a reason from a closed list. "The rating is bad" is not one of them.
moderationDesk.revertNote: Putting back online clears the reason and the moderation stamp.
moderationDesk.hiddenByAuthor: Hidden by its author, not by moderation
moderationDesk.applicationsShared: Queue shared with sales — the founder's decision.
moderationDesk.approveApplicationDescription: Creates {{business}}, makes the applicant its owner and emails them.
moderationDesk.rejectApplicationDescription: {{business}} — the reason you write is emailed to the applicant.
moderationDesk.rejectionReasonHint: One sentence is enough, but it is required: an empty rejection explains nothing.
moderationDesk.contestedWarning: {{total}} live requests on this profile. Compare the evidence before deciding — never last-in-wins.
moderationDesk.approveClosesRivals: Approving automatically closes the {{total}} other live requests on this profile.
moderationDesk.supportViewDescription: Opens an audited 30-minute session on {{organization}}, with a permanent banner. No payment action is possible there.
moderationDesk.supportViewLimit: It does not widen your reading: you still won't see the shop's locations or its team.
moderationDesk.refusalReasonNotAllowed: That reason is not in the allowed vocabulary.
moderationDesk.refusalRevertRequiresAdmin: Only an admin can undo a moderation decision.
moderationDesk.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role does not allow this.

posters.title: QR posters
posters.subtitle: Codes printed ahead of time, assigned once the shop is known.
posters.noAccess: This desk isn't visible with your role
posters.noAccessBody: Generating a batch, revoking a poster and preparing a mailing are reserved to the founder and the admins.
posters.generateHint: A hundred posters can go to the printer before anyone knows which shops will get them.
posters.labelHint: How you will recognise it later: "October print run", "Lyon tour".
posters.generatedBody: One page per code, ready to print.
posters.pdfLanguageHint: Independent from the interface language. Six languages only: the standard PDF fonts cannot write Japanese, Arabic, Russian or Chinese, and embedding a font that covers them would weigh several megabytes.
posters.pdfUnprintableBody: The chosen translation uses characters the standard PDF fonts cannot write. Pick another language rather than a PDF full of question marks.
posters.pdfPromise: Text refused: it promises a notification
posters.pdfPromiseBody: In-app notifications do not exist yet. Fix the translation before printing — found "{{word}}".
posters.pdfHeadline: Your turn, live on your phone.
posters.pdfAction: Scan this code: you see your place in the queue live, so you can step out for a coffee and keep an eye on it.
posters.pdfCodeLabel: QR damaged? Type this code instead
posters.letterBody:
FadeUp is the app where customers find a barber and follow the queue live from their phone.

Your shop has a page there that nobody has claimed yet. The enclosed poster carries a code that belongs to no shop.

Scan it: it takes you to your page. Claim it — it is free, and someone at FadeUp reviews your request — then open your queue. The poster attaches to it with a single scan, and customers who scan it see your queue live: they can wait outside without losing their turn.
posters.letterProofHeading: What we already measure on your listing
posters.letterCallToAction: Scan the QR on this letter, or the one on the poster: both carry the same code. It takes you to your page; the poster only attaches to your shop once your queue is open.
posters.proofViewsAllTime: Listing views since it went live: {{value}}
posters.batchesHint: When, how many, and what became of each one.
posters.batchesEmpty: No batch has been generated yet.
posters.pickBatch: Open a batch to see its posters.
posters.postersEmpty: No poster in this batch for this filter.
posters.revokeBody: An assigned poster cannot be redirected: to give it to another shop, revoke it first, then assign it again.
posters.revokeReasonHint: Required — the server refuses a revocation without one.
posters.reassignBody: This poster was revoked. Assigning it again puts it back in service for the chosen location.
posters.locationsEmpty: No location you can assign a poster to.
posters.letterIntro: One envelope holds the letter and the poster, in a single PDF. The same code serves both.
posters.letterMarks: Preparing it marks the poster as gone by post to that prospect.
posters.letterOnlyFree: Only a free poster goes out by post.
posters.letterAddressMissing: No postal address is known for this prospect: the PDF will carry no address block.
posters.proofNone: Analytics says nothing about this prospect: the letter will go out with no piece of evidence.
posters.proofIncluded: The letter will carry these real figures:
posters.downloadMailing: Download the letter and the poster
posters.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role does not allow this.
posters.refusalNotFree: Only a free poster goes out by post.
posters.refusalAlreadyAssigned: This poster is already assigned: revoke it before assigning it again.
posters.refusalCountOutOfRange: A batch holds between 1 and 500 posters.
posters.refusalProspectNotVisible: This prospect isn't visible with your role.
posters.refusalArgumentsRequired: A code and a location are expected.
posters.refusalGeneratorExhausted: The code generator has no free code left. Try again.

salesDesk.title: Sales
salesDesk.subtitle: What to check before picking up the phone.
salesDesk.noAccess: This desk isn't visible with your role
salesDesk.noAccessBody: Only internal sales roles can open the CRM.
salesDesk.pipelineHint: Counted by stage and by origin, so the difference is visible without a click.
salesDesk.pipelineEmpty: No prospect in the funnel yet.
salesDesk.originFieldHint: Seen on site by an intern.
salesDesk.selectProspect: Pick a prospect to see its real numbers and where its follow-ups stand.
salesDesk.notPublished: This record isn't published: there is nothing to measure yet
salesDesk.notPublishedBody: The counters aren't zero — they don't exist. Publish the record and the numbers start.
salesDesk.pendingCallout: Interest requests waiting: {{count}}. A real customer is waiting for an answer — make this call first.
salesDesk.outreachHint: FadeUp sends three automatic follow-ups per interest request, between 8am and 9pm in the recipient's timezone. This screen shows them; it never triggers them.
salesDesk.blockAlreadyCustomer: already a customer or on trial
salesDesk.blockChannelDoNotContact: email channel marked do not contact
salesDesk.blockOptInRequired: explicit opt-in required in this country
salesDesk.noRequests: No interest request yet — nothing to follow up.
salesDesk.loggedContactsHint: Calls and visits typed in by the team. These are not the automatic follow-ups.
salesDesk.publishBody: Publishing emails the professional the GDPR article 14 notice, makes the record public and puts the legal responsibility on FadeUp. The action is logged.
salesDesk.onboardingHint: Shared with moderation. The full handling lives on the application screen.

supportDesk.title: Support
supportDesk.subtitle: Take the call, find the file, act.
supportDesk.notForYourRole: Support isn't visible with your role.
supportDesk.notForYourRoleHint: This screen is for the roles that handle tickets.
supportDesk.deadlinesHint: The deadline is computed by the database and refreshes every minute.
supportDesk.deadlinesNotVisible: Withdrawal requests aren't visible with your role.
supportDesk.completeWithdrawalDescription: The profile leaves the marketplace. The note is optional and stays in the log.
supportDesk.queueHint: Sorted by the database: overdue first, then deadline, then date.
supportDesk.queueEmptyMine: No ticket is assigned to you.
supportDesk.newCallDescription: The subject is enough to open it. The rest can come later.
supportDesk.originsNotWired: A report or an inbound email doesn't open a ticket automatically yet.
supportDesk.openShopDossierHint: Every file consultation is written to the audit log.
supportDesk.noCustomerSearch: There is no customer lookup by phone or email: a customer file can only be opened from a ticket that references it.
supportDesk.ticketOverdue: This ticket is past its deadline.
supportDesk.teamNotVisible: The team list isn't visible with your role.
supportDesk.resolveDescription: A resolution needs its words: what was done stays on file.
supportDesk.threadAppendOnly: A message is never edited nor deleted.
supportDesk.dossierNotForYourRole: Files aren't visible with your role.
supportDesk.subscriptionReadOnly: Subscription is read-only: support has no payment action, and that is not an oversight.
supportDesk.cancelAppointmentDescription: The customer and the shop will see the cancellation. The reason stays in the log.
supportDesk.removeQueueEntryDescription: The person leaves the queue. The reason stays in the log.
supportDesk.resendEmailDescription: A new identical email goes out. The original is never replayed.
supportDesk.refusal_not_authorized: Your role does not handle support tickets.
supportDesk.refusal_origin_not_wired: This origin is not wired yet: nothing feeds it.
supportDesk.refusal_withdrawal_required: A withdrawal ticket needs the request it handles.
supportDesk.refusal_assignee_not_support: This account does not handle tickets: it would never see this one.
supportDesk.refusal_kind_reserved: This kind of message is written by the system, not by hand.
supportDesk.refusal_dossier_not_authorized: Your role does not open files.
supportDesk.refusal_queue_entry_not_waiting: This person is no longer waiting: their service has started or ended.
supportDesk.refusal_queue_remove_required: Your role cannot remove anyone from a queue.
supportDesk.refusal_email_bounced: This email bounced: resending it would only bounce again.
supportDesk.refusal_email_suppressed: This address is on the suppression list: FadeUp no longer writes to it.
supportDesk.refusal_email_not_transactional: Only a transactional email can be resent; outreach follows its own cadence.

settings.title: Platform defaults
settings.subtitle: What FadeUp applies when a salon has decided nothing itself. Every change is logged with who, what and why.
settings.noAccess: These defaults are not visible with your role
settings.noAccessBody: Changing what FadeUp applies to every salon is reserved for the founder and platform admins.
settings.noPricingHere: No prices here. The plan grid lives in the plan catalogue, and the database refuses to hold a price on this page.
settings.familyQueueHint: Inherited by every salon that has not set its own queue thresholds. A salon that sets them stops following.
settings.familyBookingHint: Applies to every salon, with no per-salon override today.
settings.familySearchHint: The weights of the FadeUp feed. Marketplace search has no score today and is not affected.
settings.familyNotificationsHint: When prospecting email may leave, and how the three follow-ups are spaced.
settings.listError: The defaults could not be read
settings.reasonHint: Optional, kept in the audit log next to the change.
settings.savedPropagated_one: Applied to {{count}} salon that was still following the default.
settings.savedPropagated_other: Applied to {{count}} salons that were still following the default.
settings.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role may not change platform defaults.
settings.refusalUnknownKey: The server does not know this setting.
settings.refusalOutOfRange: The value is outside the range the server allows.
settings.refusalNotAnInteger: This setting only accepts whole numbers.
settings.refusalNoChange: This setting already holds that value.
settings.refusalMissingArgument: A key and a value are required.

queue_capacity_per_barber.label: Queue capacity per barber
queue_capacity_per_barber.effect: Applies to every salon that has not set its own limit. Salons that set theirs keep it. How many salons are still following cannot be known before the change; the number actually reached is reported once it is saved.

queue_call_grace_minutes.label: Grace period after a call
queue_call_grace_minutes.effect: How long a called customer keeps their place before the queue moves on. Same inheritance: applies to every salon that has not set its own, and salons that set theirs keep it.

queue_geofence_meters.label: Check-in radius
queue_geofence_meters.effect: How close a customer must be to the shop to check in. Same inheritance: applies to every salon that has not set its own, and salons that set theirs keep it.

booking_window_days.label: Booking window
booking_window_days.effect: Affects every salon. The customer date picker reads this value, so lowering it shortens what customers can book.

booking_max_future_per_customer.label: Future bookings per customer
booking_max_future_per_customer.effect: How many appointments one customer may hold at the same time. Affects every salon: a customer at the limit is refused the next booking.

booking_free_cancel_hours.label: Free cancellation window
booking_free_cancel_hours.effect: Display only: FadeUp never refuses a late cancellation (product rule). This sets when the customer is warned that the cancellation is late.

notifications_quiet_hours_start.label: Quiet hours start
notifications_quiet_hours_start.effect: No prospecting email leaves between these hours, in the recipient's own timezone.

notifications_quiet_hours_end.label: Quiet hours end
notifications_quiet_hours_end.effect: No prospecting email leaves between these hours, in the recipient's own timezone.

notifications_prospect_touch2_delay_hour.label: Second follow-up delay
notifications_prospect_touch2_delay_hour.effect: The second touch waits this long after the request. The number of touches stays at three and is not adjustable.

notifications_prospect_touch3_lead_hours.label: Last follow-up lead time
notifications_prospect_touch3_lead_hours.effect: The last touch goes this long before the request expires. The number of touches stays at three and is not adjustable.

search_weight_relationship.label: Feed ranking — relationship
search_weight_relationship.effect: The reader follows the author. Weights the FadeUp feed ranking only: it does NOT affect marketplace search, which has no score today.

search_weight_proximity.label: Feed ranking — proximity
search_weight_proximity.effect: Distance from the customer's position, decreasing. Weights the FadeUp feed ranking only: it does NOT affect marketplace search, which has no score today.

search_weight_freshness.label: Feed ranking — freshness
search_weight_freshness.effect: Linear decay over seven days. Weights the FadeUp feed ranking only: it does NOT affect marketplace search, which has no score today.

search_weight_engagement.label: Feed ranking — engagement
search_weight_engagement.effect: Likes, capped at fifty. Weights the FadeUp feed ranking only: it does NOT affect marketplace search, which has no score today.

search_weight_bookability.label: Feed ranking — bookability
search_weight_bookability.effect: The post is tied to at least one bookable service. Weights the FadeUp feed ranking only: it does NOT affect marketplace search, which has no score today.

promotions.title: Promotions
promotions.subtitle: Discounts carried by Stripe. FadeUp says who may use one, until when and how many times — it never computes a price.
promotions.noAccess: Promotions are not visible with your role
promotions.noAccessBody: Reading and applying commercial discounts is reserved for FadeUp commercial staff.
promotions.yourCeiling: Your role may grant up to {{percent}}% off, for up to {{months}} months.
promotions.noDirectory: Applying a discount here needs the organization directory, which your role cannot read. A salon can still redeem the code itself, and an admin can apply one for you.
promotions.listHint: A promotion Stripe has not confirmed cannot be applied — the server refuses it, and so does this screen.
promotions.listError: The promotions could not be read
promotions.listEmptyBody: Create one and FadeUp asks Stripe for the matching coupon straight away.
promotions.codeHint: 4 to 24 letters or digits, no spaces.
promotions.stripeWaitingBody: Stripe has not confirmed this coupon, so the discount does not exist yet and cannot be applied.
promotions.createDescription: FadeUp creates the matching Stripe coupon. It is not usable until Stripe confirms it.
promotions.amountHint: In euros; sent to Stripe in cents.
promotions.endsAtHint: Optional. Leave empty for no end date.
promotions.maxRedemptionsHint: Optional. Leave empty for no cap.
promotions.eligiblePlansHint: Leave everything unticked for all payable plans. A discount on a free plan is a discount on nothing.
promotions.catalogError: The plan catalogue could not be read
promotions.catalogEmpty: No payable plan in the catalogue
promotions.applyBody: The discount is posted on the salon subscription. A salon can only hold one discount at a time.
promotions.organizationsError: The salons could not be read
promotions.endWarning: This cannot be undone: the promotion closes for good and its code stops working. Discounts already granted stay in place.
promotions.revokeWarning: This cannot be undone: the discount is removed from the salon subscription at Stripe, and the next invoice is at full price.
promotions.redemptionsHint: Two paths reach this list: a code typed by the salon, or a discount posted by a sales rep. Each line says which.
promotions.redemptionsError: The discounts could not be read
promotions.redemptionsEmptyFiltered: No discount granted for this promotion
promotions.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role may not do this.
promotions.refusalBadCode: A promotion code is 4 to 24 letters or digits.
promotions.refusalBadPercent: A percentage discount is between 0 and 100.
promotions.refusalBadAmount: An amount discount must be positive.
promotions.refusalBadDuration: A repeating promotion lasts between 1 and 36 months.
promotions.refusalBadPlan: One of the plans does not exist or is not payable.
promotions.refusalAboveRoleCeiling: This is above what your role may grant.
promotions.refusalNoCeiling: No promotion ceiling is defined for your role.
promotions.refusalNotStarted: This promotion has not started yet.
promotions.refusalExhausted: This promotion has reached its redemption cap.
promotions.refusalNotSynced: Stripe has not confirmed this coupon, so it cannot be applied.
promotions.refusalPlanNotEligible: The salon plan is not eligible for this promotion.
promotions.refusalAlreadyDiscounted: This salon already holds an active discount.
promotions.refusalNotActive: There is no active discount with that identifier.

funnel.title: Acquisition funnel
funnel.subtitle: Read from the operational tables, stage by stage. What the schema cannot attribute is written as such, never as a zero.
funnel.noAccess: The acquisition funnel is not visible with your role
funnel.noAccessBody: Reading the acquisition machine is reserved for FadeUp commercial staff.
funnel.breakdownWarning: Trials and subscriptions are left out of a breakdown: nothing in the schema links an organization back to a prospect, so they belong to no zone and no origin.
funnel.bucketUnzonedBody: Prospects with no usable city. They belong to no zone, and a missing city never becomes an attribution.
funnel.stagePublishedHint: External profiles put online during the window.
funnel.stageRequestsHint: Customers who asked one of those profiles for an appointment.
funnel.stageEmailsHint: Prospecting emails that actually left — queued is not sent.
funnel.stageClaimsHint: Professionals who asked to take over their profile.
funnel.stageTrialsHint: Counted across the whole platform: they cannot be traced back to a prospect.
funnel.stageSubscriptionsHint: Moves to a paid plan through billing. Internal grants are not counted.
funnel.notAttributableBody: Nothing in the schema links an organization back to a prospect, so this stage cannot be tied to this bucket. A zero here would read as a failure that never happened.
funnel.minSample: The server withholds a rate below {{min}} cases.
funnel.rateNotComparableBody: The population changes at this step — prospects on one side, organizations on the other. A percentage would be an exact number answering the wrong question.
funnel.emptyWindowBody: Every stage is empty over this window. Widen the period rather than reading six bars at zero.
funnel.noBucketsBody: No prospect in this window falls into a zone or carries an origin.
funnel.loadError: The funnel could not be read
funnel.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role may not read the acquisition funnel.
funnel.refusalBadWindow: The end of the window must come after its start.

worker.title: Acquisition worker
worker.subtitle: Is it polling, is it paused, is it simply not there. Measured on the heartbeat it writes itself, never declared.
worker.noAccess: The worker is not visible with your role
worker.noAccessBody: Piloting the acquisition worker is reserved for the founder and platform admins.
worker.stateError: The worker state could not be read
worker.stateMissingBody: The single state row is missing. The worker keeps working — its default is to serve — but nothing can be piloted until the row is back.
worker.runningBody: The worker is polling the database and picking up jobs.
worker.downBody: The worker process is not polling the database. This is not a pause: nothing will be picked up until the process is running again, and resuming it here will change nothing.
worker.pauseDescription: The worker keeps polling; it simply stops being served.
worker.pauseWarning: Nothing will be picked up until it is resumed. A reason is required — a pause without one is a breakdown nobody will recognise.
worker.launchDescription: The job is queued and picked up by the worker.
worker.launchWarning: A pass writes to the database and can create hundreds of prospects, each one a real professional FadeUp then owes a GDPR notice. Who launched it is logged.
worker.passLogHint: Who launched what, and what came out of it. An empty counter means the job carried none — not zero.
worker.passLogError: The pass log could not be read
worker.passLogEmptyBody: Nothing has been launched. Launching one writes to the database.
worker.refusalNotAuthorized: Your role may not pilot the worker.
